title: Source pathways: association, projection, commissural and cranial-nerve trajectories
author: NeuroImage project
objective: Explore source-defined pathway families using bounded groups, full sections and unchanged native trajectories. Distinguish computed tractography from observed anatomical boundaries.

scenes.title: Long association pathways
scenes.prompt: Compare the arcuate, inferior fronto-occipital and inferior longitudinal source bundles. Start with full template sections; magnify only after locating the selected trajectory.
scenes.note: Retained population-averaged computed trajectories with the source-declared ICBM 2009a asymmetric T1/T2 reference. Colors distinguish displayed source groups; counts describe retained computational streamlines. Endpoints and display density describe the supplied tractography. Functional interpretation, axon counts and individual nerve boundaries require their own evidence. Other datasets remain in their independent spaces.
